data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 claims inheritance from SRC_001 because the 3-digit jump D(299)->D(300) presupposes SRC_001's block partition. But SRC_001 does not establish that partition; its actual content concerns front-matter vs body numbering. The 3-digit jump follows directly from the standard problem (all numbers 100-999 have 3 digits), so the claimed inheritance is not a genuine relation to SRC_001.
